ai_content.desc_en: In a world where friends play a major role in an individual's life, this fascinating film shows us how our relationships with others can turn into real relationships, through the story of a fox spirit who aims to provide matchmaking services, where she collaborates with a man searching for a wife, to show us how our relationships with others can turn into real relationships.
